analysis.title: Pastel 3D Storefront Landing Page
analysis.notes: A soft-lit 3D storefront scene dominates the composition while oversized navy typography anchors the left side. Rounded white controls, pastel surfaces, and vivid magenta details create a friendly, contemporary commerce aesthetic.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a polished 3D product-render hero scene for a modern online storefront platform: a small rounded white kiosk with a glowing magenta arched window, tiny striped awning, and miniature bench, arranged on a pale geometric tiled surface with a few neutral cardboard parcels. Use soft late-afternoon lighting, subtle shadows, creamy whites, lavender-gray reflections, and vivid pink and coral accents. Compose the object large on the right with generous negative space on the left for headline placement. Add a floating rounded white navigation bar and a pill-shaped form beneath the left-side copy area, but include no readable text, logos, or brand marks.
